title: Unbrewed Telemetry Queue Events v1
description: A batch of matchmaking queue lifecycle events emitted by the engine so wait times and match rates can be estimated. Events are facts about a search, not about a game: nothing here joins to games/game_seats.

schemaVersion.description: Optional. The version of record is the request path (/v1/queue-events); producers may stamp it anyway so a stored payload is self-describing.

events.description: At least one event. An empty batch is a producer bug, not a no-op.

type.description: search_started opens a search; matched and abandoned close it.

roomId.description: Search/room id. Ties the closing event back to its search_started.

formatId.description: Stable format id, for example duel or team-2v2.

quickMatch.description: Whether the search was a quick match. Wait stats are reported split by this.

waitMs.description: Milliseconds spent searching. Optional, and only meaningful on matched/abandoned: a search_started has not waited yet.

reason.description: Why the search ended. Optional, and only meaningful on abandoned.

ts.description: Producer clock at the moment of the event.
